international.title: Lawyer calls for urgent review of Letby convictions after expert witness revelations
international.summary: Failure to disclose Peter Hindmarsh’s exclusion from practice raises ‘fundamental questions’ over nurse’s case Lucy Letby’s lawyer has said the court of appeal must urgently review her convictions, after it was revealed that a key medical witness in the prosecution’s case was barred from treating patients because of safety concerns. The Guardian revealed this week that Prof Peter Hindmarsh – a crucial expert witness who provided an opinion at Letby’s trial that two babies had been poisoned with insulin – was excluded from clinical practice in March 2023 because his hospital considered him unsafe to treat children in relation to insulin.
